name: COMPARE_OUTPUT
definition: Compare two outputs/files to find differences (diff, cmp, difflib).
distinguish: comparing two artifacts (here) vs reviewing one's own git diff (INSPECT_CHANGES)

name: RUN_LINTER
definition: Run a style/lint checker (flake8, pylint, ruff, pycodestyle, eslint) to surface style/lint violations.
distinguish: style/lint scan (here) vs static type checking (CHECK_TYPES) vs running tests (RUN_TEST_SUITE)

name: MANAGE_FILESYSTEM
definition: Manipulate files/dirs in the workspace (mkdir, mv, cp, touch, chmod, symlink) — not a source edit.
distinguish: filesystem op (here) vs editing file contents (EDIT_SOURCE) vs deleting scratch (CLEANUP_ARTIFACTS)

name: INSPECT_ENVIRONMENT
definition: Inspect the environment / installed packages / interpreter version (pip list/freeze, python --version, uname).
distinguish: checking what's installed/configured (here) vs reading repo source (READ_SOURCE)

name: FORMAT_CODE
definition: Run an auto-formatter (black, isort, autopep8, prettier, gofmt) to reformat code mechanically.
distinguish: mechanical reformat (here) vs a behavioural fix (EDIT_SOURCE) vs restructuring (REFACTOR_CODE)

name: MEASURE_PERFORMANCE
definition: Profile or benchmark code to measure timing/performance.
distinguish: measuring speed (here) vs checking correctness via tests (RUN_TEST_SUITE)

name: CONFIGURE_ENVIRONMENT
definition: Set environment variables / activate or create a virtualenv/conda env to make code or tests runnable.
distinguish: preparing the runtime env (here) vs installing packages (INSTALL_DEPENDENCY) vs building (BUILD_PROJECT)

name: COMMIT_CHANGES
definition: Record changes in version control (git add/commit/branch/tag).
distinguish: committing/branching (here) vs undoing (REVERT_CHANGE) vs viewing the diff (INSPECT_CHANGES)

name: INTERACTIVE_DEBUG
definition: Drop into an interactive debugger/REPL (pdb, ipython, python -i) to inspect runtime state.
distinguish: interactive runtime inspection (here) vs adding print/log statements (ADD_DEBUG_INSTRUMENTATION)
